title: Lifting a quotient cover over the maximal-ideal completion
statement: Let A be a Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] of depth at least three [def-weil-pbc-depth], f in its maximal ideal, U the punctured spectrum [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and q:Y→U finite etale [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism, def-weil-etale-morphism]. Assume the actual pullback of q to the inverse image of U in Spec(A/(f)) extends to a finite etale cover of Spec(A/(f)), with an isomorphism over that inverse image [def-pc-fibre-product]. Let C be the maximal-ideal completion of A [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], c:Spec C→Spec A its canonical map and W=c⁻¹(U). There is a finite etale s:E→Spec C and an isomorphism Y×_U W≅s⁻¹(W) commuting with the projections to W.

proof.text: Use the quotient-cover lifting lemma to obtain a finite etale E→Spec C together with an isomorphism of the quotient restrictions of Y×_U W and E restricted to W, including the equality over W₀. This step uses no depth assumption.

Package the two morphisms to W as objects P,Q of the morphism-property-over category of finite etale covers. The quotient isomorphism and its projection equality give an isomorphism between their images under quotient pullback. Apply full faithfulness on the punctured completion and FullyFaithful.preimageIso to obtain P≅Q. Forget to schemes; MorphismProperty.Over.w supplies exactly the projection equality in the conclusion.

theorem exists_completed_etale_extension_of_depth_three_of_quotient_extension
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    (f : A) (hf : f ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)
    (hdepth : (3 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := A) A)
    (U : (Spec (.of A)).Opens)
    (hU : ∀ x : Spec (.of A), x ∈ U ↔ x ≠ IsLocalRing.closedPoint A)
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : Y ⟶ U.toScheme) [IsFinite q] [Etale q]
    (hquot :
      let i := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {f})))
      let V := i ⁻¹ᵁ U
      ∃ (F₀ : Scheme.{u}) (r₀ : F₀ ⟶ Spec (.of (A ⧸ Ideal.span {f}))),
        IsFinite r₀ ∧ Etale r₀ ∧
          ∃ e₀ : pullback q (i ∣_ U) ≅ (r₀ ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme,
            e₀.hom ≫ r₀ ∣_ V = pullback.snd q (i ∣_ U)) :
    let C := AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A
    let c := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A C))
    let W := c ⁻¹ᵁ U
    ∃ (E : Scheme.{u}) (s : E ⟶ Spec (.of C)), IsFinite s ∧ Etale s ∧
      ∃ e : pullback q (c ∣_ U) ≅ (s ⁻¹ᵁ W).toScheme,
        e.hom ≫ s ∣_ W = pullback.snd q (c ∣_ U)
